title: Implants for surgery - Femoral tibial components for partial and total knee joint prostheses, Part 1: Classifcation, definitions and designation of dimensions
clause_1_scope: This part of ISO 7207 classifies femoral and tibial components for knee joint prostheses in which one or both bearing surfaces of at least one compartment of the knee are replaced, and gives definitions of components and the designation of dimensions. Patellar components and prostheses that include an interposed floating component are not included in this part of ISO 7207.
clause_3_terminology: Femoral tibial components for partial and total knee joint prostheses

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
